---
title: "ukhsa_data_analysis"
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
```

```{r}
rhinovirus <- read_csv("data/ukhsa-chart-download-rhinovirus.csv")

gt(head(rhinovirus))
```

```{r}
weather <- read_csv("data/weather_data.csv")
```

```{r}
ggplot(weather)
```

```{r}
ggplot(weather, aes(
  x = observation_time,
  y = temperature_c
))
```

```{r}
ggplot(weather, aes(
  x = observation_time,
  y = temperature_c
)) +
  geom_line()
```

```{r}
ggplot(weather, aes(
  x = observation_time,
  y = temperature_c
)) +
  geom_line(colour = "red") +
  xlab("Date") +
  ylab("Temp (C)") +
  ggtitle("Temperature by Date")
```

```{r}
ggplot(rhinovirus, aes(
  x = date,
  y = metric_value
)) +
  geom_line()
```

```{r}
ggplot(rhinovirus, aes(
  x = date,
  y = metric_value
)) +
  geom_line(colour = "blue") +
  xlab("Date") +
  ylab("Percentage") +
  ggtitle("Percentage Value")
```
